screens.title: Queue
screens.caption: Every document that arrived — by email, WhatsApp, portal or link — read, matched and sorted into clean or needs-a-decision. Nobody re-types anything.

screens.title: Invoice DP/26-27/1183
screens.caption: The document beside what was read from it, field by field with confidence — and the match against the PO, the GRN and the arithmetic.

screens.title: Matching rules
screens.caption: Your matching rules in plain terms: tolerances, who approves what, which documents post on their own — the AI applies them, a person owns the exceptions.

screens.title: Exceptions
screens.caption: The exception queue is short and specific: what is wrong, what the system suggests, and one click to resolve — with the query already drafted.

screens.title: Posting
screens.caption: Clean documents post to your accounting system as vouchers, with the document attached — so the audit trail is the document itself.

screens.title: Sources
screens.caption: Email inboxes, WhatsApp numbers, buyer portals and transfer links — watched continuously. A missed document is reported as missed, never silently dropped.

screens.title: Batch · 30 tech packs from one link
screens.caption: One link, thirty PDFs. Each file is matched to its style by the code in the filename, filled in where the style exists, and creates an unconfirmed style where it doesn't.
